theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} [LinearOrder α] [DenselyOrdered α] {s t : Set α} (hsf : s.Finite) (hs : s.Nonempty) (htf : t.Finite) (ht : t.Nonempty) (H : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ t, x < y) : ∃ b, (∀ x ∈ s, x < b) ∧ ∀ y ∈ t, b < y := by
  let s' : Finset α := s.toFinset
  let t' : Finset α := t.toFinset
  have h_s_nonempty : s'.Nonempty := by exact hsf.elim hs
  have h_t_nonempty : t'.Nonempty := by exact htf.elim ht
  have h_s_t_order : ∀ x ∈ s', ∀ y ∈ t', x < y := by intro x hx y hy; exact H x hx y hy
  let h_no_min_s : ¬∃ a, ∀ x ∈ s', x ≤ a :=
    by contrapose! h_s_t_order; intro h; cases h with a; intro x hx; exact lt_irrefl a (h_s_t_order x hx a (le_rfl a))
  let h_no_max_t : ¬∃ a, ∀ x ∈ t', a ≤ x :=
    by contrapose! h_s_t_order; intro h; cases h with a; intro y hy; exact lt_irrefl a (h_s_t_order a (le_rfl a) y hy)
  let h_no_min_max : ¬(∃ a, ∀ x ∈ s', x ≤ a) ∧ ¬(∃ a, ∀ x ∈ t', a ≤ x) := ⟨h_no_min_s, h_no_max_t⟩
  exact Order.exists_between_finsets s' t' h_s_t_order h_no_min_max h_s_nonempty h_t_nonempty
